personal-laser-defense-equipment.title: Personal laser defense
personal-laser-defense-equipment.description: Inserted into armor to automatically fire at nearby enemies.

discharge-defense-equipment.title: Discharge defense
discharge-defense-equipment.description: Inserted into armor to damage, push back, and stun nearby enemies when activated using the remote.

fission-reactor-equipment.title: Portable fission reactor
fission-reactor-equipment.description: Inserted into armor to power other equipment.

exoskeleton-equipment.title: Exoskeleton equipment
exoskeleton-equipment.description: Inserted into armor to increase movement speed. You can equip multiple exoskeletons at once.

personal-roboport-equipment.title: Personal roboport
personal-roboport-equipment.description: Inserted into armor to allow construction robots to work from your inventory.

personal-roboport-mk2-equipment.title: Personal roboport MK2
personal-roboport-mk2-equipment.description: Inserted into armor to allow many construction robots to work from your inventory.

fluid-handling.title: Fluid handling
fluid-handling.description: Various ways to store and transport fluids.

oil-processing.title: Oil processing
oil-processing.description: Crude oil refining used for manufacturing plastics, sulfur, and fuels.

advanced-oil-processing.title: Advanced oil processing
advanced-oil-processing.description: Crude oil refining with additional products that can be refined further.

coal-liquefaction.title: Coal liquefaction
coal-liquefaction.description: A processing technique to turn coal into oil products with the use of steam and heavy oil.

sulfur-processing.title: Sulfur processing
sulfur-processing.description: A highly reactive non-metallic chemical used to produce sulfuric acid and explosive items.

plastics.title: Plastics
plastics.description: Synthetic polymeric materials that can be molded into solid objects.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Allows you to research upgrade modules that can be inserted into machines.

speed-module.title: Speed module
speed-module.description: A module that makes a machine work faster, but it also increases its energy consumption.

speed-module-2.title: Speed module 2
speed-module-2.description: A module that makes a machine work faster, but it also increases its energy consumption.

speed-module-3.title: Speed module 3
speed-module-3.description: A module that makes a machine work faster, but it also increases its energy consumption.

productivity-module.title: Productivity module
productivity-module.description: A module that allows a machine to make more products from the same amount of ingredients, but it also increases energy consumption and reduces speed.

productivity-module-2.title: Productivity module 2
productivity-module-2.description: A module that allows a machine to make more products from the same amount of ingredients, but it also increases energy consumption and reduces speed.

productivity-module-3.title: Productivity module 3
productivity-module-3.description: A module that allows a machine to make more products from the same amount of ingredients, but it also increases energy consumption and reduces speed.

efficiency-module.title: Efficiency module
efficiency-module.description: A module that reduces the energy consumption of a machine.

efficiency-module-2.title: Efficiency module 2
efficiency-module-2.description: A module that reduces the energy consumption of a machine.

efficiency-module-3.title: Efficiency module 3
efficiency-module-3.description: A module that reduces the energy consumption of a machine.

defender.title: Defender
defender.description: Most basic type of combat robot. Follows and helps the player for a short time period.

distractor.title: Distractor
distractor.description: Intermediate type of combat robot. Stays on the deployed position to shoot and distract enemies.

destroyer.title: Destroyer
destroyer.description: Most advanced type of combat robot. Follows and helps the player for a limited time period.

uranium-mining.title: Uranium mining
uranium-mining.description: Allows you to use [fluid=sulfuric-acid] in [entity=electric-mining-drill] to mine [entity=uranium-ore]

uranium-processing.title: Uranium processing
uranium-processing.description: Uranium ore is processed in centrifuges into uranium-238, with a chance to result in a richer uranium-235. Both are needed to create uranium fuel cells.

nuclear-power.title: Nuclear power
nuclear-power.description: Powerful and sophisticated method of power generation using uranium fuel cells.

kovarex-enrichment-process.title: Kovarex enrichment process
kovarex-enrichment-process.description: The process to create uranium-235 from uranium-238. It requires a large amount of uranium-235 as a catalyst.

nuclear-fuel-reprocessing.title: Nuclear fuel reprocessing
nuclear-fuel-reprocessing.description: The process of reprocessing used uranium fuel cells to create uranium-238.

mining-productivity-1.title: Mining productivity 1
mining-productivity-1.description: Increased yield from all mining drills and pumpjacks.

mining-productivity-2.title: Mining productivity 2
mining-productivity-2.description: Increased yield from all mining drills and pumpjacks.

mining-productivity-3.title: Mining productivity 3
mining-productivity-3.description: Increased yield from all mining drills and pumpjacks.

mining-productivity-4.title: Mining productivity
mining-productivity-4.description: Increased yield from all mining drills and pumpjacks.

artillery.title: Artillery
artillery.description: Long range cannon mounted on a turret or train wagon. Used to automatically fire at distant enemy structures, or can be manually targeted at even longer distances.

spidertron.title: Spidertron
spidertron.description: A versatile vehicle capable of traversing rough terrain. It's equipped with fast-firing rocket launchers controlled by manual or automatic targeting. Can be driven manually or using the spidertron remote.

circuit-network.title: Circuit network
circuit-network.description: Gives you better control over your machines by interconnecting them with wires and making them react to signals.

elevated-rail.title: Elevated rail
elevated-rail.description: Raised rail that can be placed over obstacles or water to reach new areas or make more efficient rail networks.

bob-electrolysis-1.title: Electrolysis 1
bob-electrolysis-1.description: Electrolysis is used to separate elements from a liquid.

bob-electrolysis-2.title: Electrolysis 2
bob-electrolysis-2.description: Electrolysis is used to separate elements from a liquid.

bob-chemical-processing-1.title: Chemical processing 1
bob-chemical-processing-1.description: Research into to use and production of chemicals.

bob-chemical-processing-2.title: Chemical processing 2
bob-chemical-processing-2.description: Research into to use and production of chemicals.

bob-alloy-processing.title: Alloy processing
bob-alloy-processing.description: Learn how to combine more than one ingredient to make an alloy.

bob-aluminium-processing.title: Aluminium processing
bob-aluminium-processing.description: Research how to purify aluminium, a fairly strong light weight metal.

bob-silicon-processing.title: Silicon processing
bob-silicon-processing.description: Research how to purify silicon for use in electronics.

bob-titanium-processing.title: Titanium processing
bob-titanium-processing.description: Titanium is a very strong light weight metal, but hard to separate from its ore.

bob-tungsten-processing.title: Tungsten processing
bob-tungsten-processing.description: Tungsten has a very high melting point, let's research how to refine it another way.

bob-invar-processing.title: Invar processing
bob-invar-processing.description: Invar is an iron nickel alloy, maybe we can use this for something.

bob-nitinol-processing.title: Nitinol processing
bob-nitinol-processing.description: Nitinol is a nickel titanium alloy, let's see what we can use it for.

bob-tungsten-alloy-processing.title: Tungsten alloy processing
bob-tungsten-alloy-processing.description: Research how to make tungsten based alloys, this might make it even more useful.
